units.title: SG-4.1.3 · Replace Phaser 4-only APIs with 3.90 equivalents in the Phaser modules
Act: Document the 3.90 API targets in config.ts and createGame.ts
Act: Document the 3.90 lifecycle APIs in BootScene and PhaserHost
Verify: config, createGame and events use only 3.90 APIs unit tests

tests.id: phaser390Config.test.ts > builds a 640x360 AUTO pixel-art config with FIT scaling
tests.name: builds a 640x360 AUTO pixel-art config with FIT scaling
tests.title: builds a 640x360 AUTO pixel-art config with FIT scaling
tests.scenario: Given a parent element and no scenes; When buildGameConfig is called; Then type is 0, width 640, height 360, render.pixelArt is true and scale.mode is 3
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaser390Config.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: phaser390Config.test.ts > passes the built config to the Phaser.Game constructor
tests.name: passes the built config to the Phaser.Game constructor
tests.title: passes the built config to the Phaser.Game constructor
tests.scenario: Given a parent element and a scene list; When createGame is called; Then Phaser.Game is constructed once with the buildGameConfig output
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaser390Config.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: phaser390Config.test.ts > keeps the config, createGame and events sources free of Phaser 4-only symbols
tests.name: keeps the config, createGame and events sources free of Phaser 4-only symbols
tests.title: keeps the config, createGame and events sources free of Phaser 4-only symbols
tests.scenario: Given the config, createGame and events source files; When scanned for Phaser 4-only symbols; Then none match, and events.ts does not import from 'phaser'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaser390Config.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: BootScene and PhaserHost 3.90 lifecycle unit tests

tests.id: phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx > BootScene 3.90 lifecycle > unsubscribes from the shared Zustand store when the SHUTDOWN event fires
tests.name: unsubscribes from the shared Zustand store when the SHUTDOWN event fires
tests.title: BootScene unsubscribes from the shared Zustand store when the SHUTDOWN event fires
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene that subscribed during create(), When the SHUTDOWN callback runs, Then the store unsubscribe spy is called once

tests.id: phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx > PhaserHost 3.90 lifecycle > calls scale.refresh() on the live game when the container is resized
tests.name: calls scale.refresh() on the live game when the container is resized
tests.title: PhaserHost refreshes the Phaser scale when the container resizes
tests.scenario: Given a mounted PhaserHost with one live game, When the ResizeObserver callback fires, Then scale.refresh() is called once

tests.id: phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx > PhaserHost 3.90 lifecycle > calls destroy(true) exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.name: calls destroy(true) exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.title: PhaserHost destroys the game with destroy(true) exactly once on unmount
tests.scenario: Given a mounted PhaserHost with one live game, When the host unmounts, Then destroy(true) is called exactly once

tests.id: phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx > Phaser 3.90 source compatibility > contains no Phaser 4-only filter API in BootScene or PhaserHost
tests.name: contains no Phaser 4-only filter API in BootScene or PhaserHost
tests.title: BootScene and PhaserHost sources contain no Phaser 4-only filter API
tests.scenario: Given the BootScene and PhaserHost sources, When scanned for Filters, enableFilters or setFilter, Then no match is found
